label: Emergency Bug Fix
description: Critical-priority fix of a production defect with change review and regression checks.

tasks.title: Reproduce and locate the bug
tasks.mission: Reproduce the reported defect from the bug scan evidence and locate the root cause (file, selector, line).

tasks.title: Fix the defect
tasks.mission: Apply the smallest change that fixes the root cause; do not touch unrelated code.

tasks.title: Review the fix diff
tasks.mission: Review the diff for correctness, regressions and unintended deletions.

tasks.title: Regression visual check
tasks.mission: Render all viewports and confirm nothing regressed.

tasks.title: Fix notes
tasks.mission: Write docs/CHANGELOG.md entry describing the defect, root cause and fix.
